title: Privacy and consent
purpose: OPD clinical intake and consultation at this hospital
fullText:
PLACEHOLDER NOTICE — NOT APPROVED FOR PATIENT USE.

This wording is a development placeholder. It has not been reviewed or approved by the hospital's legal or clinical governance function, and it must be replaced through the governance console before any real patient is asked to agree to it.

What we collect
We collect your basic details, the health information you tell us, any documents you choose to upload, and the summary prepared for your doctor.

Why we collect it
So that the doctor you see today has your information ready. It is used for your consultation at this hospital and for the hospital's own records.

What we do not do
This kiosk does not diagnose you and does not prescribe treatment. Everything it prepares is a draft for your doctor to check. Your doctor decides what goes into your medical record.

Your choices
You may decline. If you decline, this kiosk will not continue, and you can still be seen at the counter in the usual way. You may choose to tell the doctor something directly instead of entering it here. You may withdraw your consent later by asking hospital staff.

How long we keep it
According to this hospital's records retention policy.

Who can see it
Authorised hospital staff involved in your care.
